$comment: The widget's postMessage protocol (PP-W12.8, TARGET-ARCHITECTURE §3.1). Every message the widget frame sends to the embedding page (events), every message it accepts from it or from its own windows (inbound), and the error codes, statuses and setup types events carry. Messages are {type, payload}. test/protocol.test.ts fails when the widget posts or accepts a type not listed here, or an event's payload has a key its entry lacks. The SDK repository tests against a pinned copy. Treat every list as open: a newer widget may add a type, a key or a code.

envelope.type: string, one of the names below

customdomain:ready.when: the frame loaded and listens for init

payload.deferred: boolean? (the setup continues in the background after close)
payload.error: {code: ErrorCode, title: string, details?: string}? (after an error screen)

customdomain:success.when: the domain went live, or a reconnect renewed its key

payload.state: string? (integrator OAuth: the state of the pushed request the widget ran for)

customdomain:fallback.when: once per domain, when the person is sent to the records

customdomain:request-close.when: the person asked to close and the host delegates dismissal

customdomain:shared.when: a setup link was handed to someone else

customdomain:purchase.when: the buy flow made a checkout session

customdomain:doc-click.when: the person opened the integrator's setup documentation

customdomain:token-expired.when: the token expired and the host gave no fresh one

customdomain:init.from: the embedding page, once per mount; pins the host origin

payload.requestUri: string? (integrator OAuth: a pushed request, redeemed once instead of the token)
payload.config: object? (the widget options, see the SDK reference)

customdomain:token.from: the pinned host, answering a token refresh

customdomain:oauth.from: the control plane's sign-in finish page, or the widget's own sign-in popup

sheet.$comment: Between the widget and the secure sign-in sheet it opens, both of this widget's origin; never seen by the host.
